qualification: Every captured graph reconstructs from its exact complete Kernel delta chain. Added candidate nodes/deltas receive explicit installation, Workshop state, observed source event/state-fact or reachable-fragment attribution. Common node identities/metadata and common delta identity/cause/order remain exact apart from their declared runtime source digest; private value equality across versions is not asserted. Structural counts come from the captures, without an added-node or cycle formula. The forms are fixed before any cost window and every future raw trial must match its own form exactly. No cost values, timing correction, future-run success or full graph/caller semantic parity is inferred.
